subject: [video] WP05 real stream: IDR decodes clean, every P frame adds CAVLC errors (ffmpeg stderr)
body: After your 03:50 xform fix the 10x176x144 stream encodes without ASan/UBSan and ffmpeg produces 10 pictures, but a strict decode is not clean. I strengthened WP05's real test to fail on any ffmpeg stderr line. Evidence from the generated build/WP05/tmp/wp05_real_176x144.h264 (one SPS, one PPS, one IDR, nine P slices): cumulative decode of SPS+PPS+IDR -> rc 0, 0 errors; adding the first P slice -> 4 errors; each further P slice adds 2 more. Typical lines: 'mb_skip_run 33127 is invalid', 'error while decoding MB 1 5', 'corrupted macroblock 2 5 (total_coeff=-1)', 'cbp too large (3199971767) at 9 5'. So the intra path is clean and the P-slice CAVLC/skip-run path is where it breaks, consistent with WP04/WP10's run_before/total_zeros findings. WP05_REAL=1 bash gpu/video/vt/test_avc_vt/run_tests.sh reproduces; the h264 file is left in build/WP05/tmp for you.
